description: This file contains unit tests for the ExternalLoginKeysManager class, verifying different scenarios of retrieving or generating external login keys in HTTP requests.

classes.name: ExternalLoginKeysManagerTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for ExternalLoginKeysManager, testing retrieval and generation of external login keys from HttpServletRequest objects.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyReturnsKeyFromRequest
methods.description: Tests that getExternalLoginKey retrieves the 'externalLoginKey' attribute from the request.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyReturnsEmptyKeyIfUserLoginIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that if the userLogin attribute is missing, the method returns an empty string.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyReturnsKeyFromSessionForAjaxRequests
methods.description: Checks that for AJAX requests, the key is retrieved from the session attribute.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyGeneratesNewKey
methods.description: Verifies that a new external login key is generated, set as request and session attributes, and starts with 'EL'.
